name: Opened big scissors.jpg
title: A pair of open scissors with black handles
usage: SCISSORS_PHOTO (slide 5). The 1280 px Commons thumbnail, cropped to the scissors (1280x500 from y=150), scaled to 1200 px wide, quality 80. Chosen because the handles run straight on from the blades, so the dashed lines and the two equal angles drawn over it are honest.

name: Тарховка, переезд Тарховской улицы сверху.jpg
title: Tarkhovka, Russia: the level crossing of Tarkhovskaya Street, seen from straight above
usage: TRACKS_PHOTO (slide 7). The 1280 px Commons thumbnail, cropped round the crossing (900x640 from x=270, y=240), quality 80. Orange lines are drawn over the two rails (parallel) and a blue line along the road (perpendicular); a drone photo from straight above, so the angles are true.

name: Painting Time.jpg
title: Two men painting a shop shutter, with a wooden ladder and a scaffold of crossed poles
usage: LADDER (slide 22), labelled “Mr Bowen’s ladder” for the word problem. The 1280 px Commons thumbnail, cropped (920x729 from x=360, y=100), quality 80. The crossed poles also make a good spoken example of vertically opposite angles.
